description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter named RecipeAdapter for displaying a list of recipes as cards within an Android application. It manages a list of RecipeEntity objects, binds their data to views, and handles user interactions such as clicks.

classes.name: RecipeAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying recipe data as card views, supporting list updates and item click handling.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Replaces the current list of recipes with a new list and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder for a recipe card item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a RecipeEntity item to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of recipe items in the list.

inner_classes.name: VH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to views within a recipe card layout and binds data to them.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a RecipeEntity's data to the views in the ViewHolder.
